title: Memory And RaptorGraph Knowledge Commit Roadmap
goal: Turn agent research and sandbox findings into durable, source-linked Memory/RaptorGraph knowledge with provenance, confidence and internal clickable references.

slice_queue.goal: Define memory candidates with source refs, model stamp, author stamp, confidence, sensitivity and expiry/recheck hints.
Map topics, pages, claims, entities and tasks into RaptorGraph nodes and edges with provenance.
Decide when abstractions can be auto-written, when review is needed and when DSGVO/local-only mode blocks API-derived content.
Ensure Memory and RaptorGraph records expose stable internal link targets for Odysseus UI without requiring Telegram links.
Write a small approved ASV BW research subset into Memory/RaptorGraph and verify it is retrievable by Odysseus.

done_definition: Memory writes include source refs, timestamps, model/author stamps and confidence.
RaptorGraph can represent relationships between source pages, topics, claims and memory records.
Internal Odysseus links are stable and clickable in the UI layer.
Telegram summaries do not need internal links, but can mention record ids if useful.
Raw website or private document content is not persisted as long-term truth.
